items.content_html: Marppa Cloud Solution (MCS) is a modular cloud platform for efficiently deploying, scaling, and managing applications. It includes lightweight virtualization with Workers, distributed networking via Mesh and Zones, and secure containerization through Nibble. Designed for fast, scalable, and flexible cloud environments.
